labeler: Root unblinded agent; supplemental blind24-case image audit by chatgpt-projects; second voice timed out
label_method: Current occupancy of same roadway over2seconds at current speed capped150m, measured along observed3D road trajectory independently of candidate spline/Euclidean/height gates; synchronized replay paths and current car centers. Not a collision or causal-interference ground truth.

excluded_before_predictions.B005: boundary ambiguity, root and blind audit
excluded_before_predictions.B021: lateral road-membership uncertainty in blind audit

limitations: Single unblinded primary labeler; candidate design known.
One public recording and traffic-enriched derived20-car roster; correlated laps/corners.
Five real pit-context controls span four main-straight passages, including two keyframes from one passage; not five independent events.
Current regional occupancy labels do not certify future collision avoidance, causal impedance or broad driving safety.
CSP0.3.1/4302 replay observations do not certify every supported CSP release or live transport freshness.
